case_name: Moti Lal v. State of Uttar Pradesh

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Moti Lal ... Appellant
versus
State of Uttar Pradesh ... Respondent
Coram: S. Murtaza Fazal Ali, A.D. Koshal, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 10 August 1979

FAZAL ALI, J.:
1. The appellant was convicted under Section 380 of the Indian Penal Code for committing theft of ornaments and clothes from inside the residential dwelling house of the complainant in village Barauli.

3. Decision: The recovery of stolen brass utensils and gold ornaments from the concealed possession of the accused shortly after the house-breaking supported the statutory presumption of theft in a dwelling house. Conviction under Section 380 IPC affirmed.
